subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Sometimes we have to accept __replacing something with something else__, if we want to move forward.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**change'** means making something different from what it is, or replacing one thing with another. (परिवर्तन)

 
 
• **Example: **She decided to** change **her career path after ten years in the industry.
 
 
 
• **'Replacing something with something else'** refers to the act of substitution or change. (किसी चीज़ को किसी अन्य चीज़ से बदलना)
 
 
• **Example: **We had to **replace** the old software with a new one to improve efficiency.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the one-word substitute for "replacing something with something else" is "**change**".

Therefore, the correct statement is 'Sometimes we have to accept **change** , if we want to move forward.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Evaluation** (मूल्यांकन): The making of a judgment about the amount, number, or value of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The** evaluation** of the new software will take a few weeks.
 
 
 
• **Invasion** (आक्रमण): An instance of invading a country or region with an armed force.
 
 
• **Example:** The** invasion** of the enemy forces led to widespread destruction.
 
 
 
• **Invention** (आविष्कार): The action of inventing something, typically a process or device.
 
 
• **Example:** The **invention** of the telephone revolutionized communication.
